parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The current page number displayed during paged queries. Value range: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: End time, UNIX timestamp, in seconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of items per page for paged queries. Value range: 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: SearchMode
parameters.description:
Query mode. Only the DstAddr field supports the following modes:

- **Exact**: Term query

- **Fuzzy**: Fuzzy query

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: Start time, UNIX timestamp, in seconds.
